approach: Add an optional `[disk] min_free_gb` setting (default 10, left out of the config digest) and a `disk` module in athena-core. The free-space reader is a plain fn held in `StateDir` beside the existing `remover`, so tests swap it. `dispatch` runs a `disk_gate` before any commit: if low, it sweeps idle workspaces' `target/` (skipping any whose job lock is held), re-reads, and if still low writes a local hold marker and returns a new `GoResult::Held`. The job stays Proposed. The same gate runs before `verifier_snapshot`: if still low there, the job closes `Failed` via `failure()` with an `environment: low disk` reason, with no marker. Drain maps Held like `needs_accepting`: not a failure, still queued, and a later drain runs the same job id. Status and drain output show 'environment: low disk' with free and required amounts.

decisions.choice: Check at two places: top of dispatch (hold) and before verifier_snapshot (retryable Failed).
decisions.reason: Matches the user's decision; Failed is what `athena retry` and drain retry already handle; nothing is left Dispatched with a marker.

rejected.why: Out of scope by the user's decision.
Low disk is environmental, not a refusal of the work; it must stay retryable.

decisions.choice: Free-space reader is a `fn(&Path) -> io::Result<u64>` on StateDir (`with_free_space`), real one runs `df -Pk`.
decisions.reason: Follows `with_remover`, changes no `Athena` literals, no new dependency or manifest edit.

rejected.option: New Athena field or trait object

rejected.why: Edits Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, which are not deliverables.

decisions.choice: `Config.disk: Option<DiskConfig>` skipped when None, reset in `reading_inputs`, accessor `min_free_gb()` defaulting to 10.
decisions.reason: Serialized config and stored digests stay unchanged; athena.toml untouched.

rejected.why: Adds a key to the serialized config and moves every digest.

decisions.choice: Hold is a local marker file `<state>/holds/<job>.json`, cleared on dispatch or close; status reads it via `JobLine.hold`.
decisions.reason: Local to the machine, no history writes; state name stays proposed so filters and hints are unchanged.

rejected.why: Writes history on every held drain.
Cannot show the amounts that blocked dispatch.

decisions.choice: Sweep removes only `jobs/<id>/target`, after `try_lock_job`; locked jobs and the one being dispatched are skipped.
decisions.reason: Reuses existing remover and lock helpers; keeps source and records.

rejected.why: Destroys kept snapshots and live records.

decisions.reason: Proven 'left queued, not a failure' pattern; a later drain picks the same job id.

decisions.choice: Keep a one-arm edit to crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs (`go_and_report`).
decisions.reason: I read main.rs: `go_and_report` matches GoResult::Reread and ::Finished exhaustively (lines ~618, 631), so a new variant cannot compile without an arm. The edit is only the Held arm (message, exit code 2); the producer must report it as a compile-forced addition outside the listed deliverables.

rejected.option: Reuse Reread/Finished to carry the hold
rejected.why: Would misreport a hold as a reread or verdict and break drain's mapping.
A wildcard in main.rs is still an edit to main.rs, and hides future variants.

risks.mitigation: On read error treat free as unknown, warn once, never hold or fail; parse POSIX `df -Pk`; tests use the injected fn.

risks.risk: New GoResult variant breaks exhaustive matches in other tests.
risks.mitigation: Compile and add arms only where exhaustive.

risks.risk: Sweep deletes target/ of a job about to run elsewhere.
risks.mitigation: try_lock_job and skip on contention; the dispatching job's own lock skips it.
Clear on dispatch and close; status shows hold only for Proposed jobs.
Option skipped when None and reset in reading_inputs; test compares inputs with and without [disk].

risks.risk: Parallel drain workers sweep at once.
risks.mitigation: Lock skip; removing a missing target/ is a no-op.

demonstrations.method: Core tests plant an idle job dir with target/ and a source file; fake free space reports 3 GB until the planted target/ is gone, then 50 GB. Run `go` with a recording UI, once for dispatch and once for the pre-checks gate.
demonstrations.observes: The sweep line and removal of target/ come before the 'dispatched' line and before the first check line.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the sweep in dispatch and the pre-checks gate, target/ would remain and no sweep line would precede dispatch or the checks.

demonstrations.method: Fake stays at 3 GB; run `go` then status and drain report.
demonstrations.observes: GoResult::Held, no dispatch commit, state still proposed (not closed or rejected); status text and drain line contain 'environment: low disk', the free amount and 10.0 GB required.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the hold the job would be dispatched or rejected and status would show plain 'proposed' without amounts.

demonstrations.method: tests/drain.rs test with RealSteps::live and a static-atomic fake free-space fn. Drain once low, then set high and drain again.
demonstrations.observes: First drain: outcome 'environment: low disk', failed count 0, stop not RepeatedFailure, job still queued. Second drain: same job id runs to a verdict.
demonstrations.fails_without: If Held were mapped as a failure or a new job, the first drain would count a failure or the second would run a different id.

demonstrations.method: Core test: space high at dispatch, low at the pre-checks gate and still low after sweep; second case frees space after the first probe.
demonstrations.observes: Closed state Failed (not Rejected), reason starts 'environment: low disk' and names retry, no holds/<job>.json, no check ran; second case: checks run.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the gate the checks run on a full disk and fail opaquely, or the job is Rejected, or a marker is left.

demonstrations.method: disk.rs unit test with three job dirs: unlocked with target/ and a source file; locked via try_lock_job with target/; one with no target/. Run the sweep.
demonstrations.observes: First target/ gone, its source file kept, locked job's target/ intact.
demonstrations.fails_without: A sweep ignoring the lock would remove the locked target/; one removing whole directories would lose the source file.

demonstrations.method: config.rs tests parse athena.toml (min_free_gb() == 10) and a toml with `[disk] min_free_gb = 3` (== 3), and compare reading_inputs with and without [disk]. `git diff` shows no athena.toml change. Read README.md and CHANGELOG.md.
demonstrations.observes: Default 10 and parse 3 pass, digest equal, athena.toml absent from diff; docs name `[disk] min_free_gb` and 'environment: low disk' and contain no 'operator'.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the config.rs default the absent-setting test would not find 10; a plain serialized field would fail the digest-equality test.

demonstrations.method: Run clippy with warnings denied, then `cargo fmt --all --check`, over the whole change including new disk.rs, the Held plumbing and the new tests.
demonstrations.observes: Both exit 0 with no warnings or diffs.
demonstrations.fails_without: Unformatted code, an unused item (such as an unused Held field or helper), or a needless clone in the new code would make clippy report a warning and fail under -D warnings, or make fmt --check print a diff and exit non-zero.
